mapper.select: SELECT id FROM carts WHERE user_id = #{customerId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.id, i.product_id, i.merchant_id, i.product_name, i.thumbnail_url, i.unit_price, i.quantity FROM cart_items i JOIN carts c ON c.id = i.cart_id WHERE c.user_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY i.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT recipient_name, phone, country_code, state_province, city, district, address_line1, address_line2, postal_code, label FROM shipping_addresses WHERE id = #{addressId} AND user_id = #{customerId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE cart_id IN (SELECT id FROM carts WHERE user_id = #{customerId}) AND id IN #{itemId}
